## 2. Implement the method in `environment.cpp`

````cpp
// ...existing code...
namespace cudarl {

void Environment::copyGridToBuffer(float* host_buffer, size_t num_elements) const {
    if (!host_buffer) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("Host buffer cannot be null");
    }
    
    size_t expected_size = static_cast<size_t>(m_state.width) * m_state.height;
    if (num_elements != expected_size) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("Buffer size mismatch");
    }
    
    // Copy from device grid to host buffer
    m_deviceGrid.copyToHost(host_buffer, num_elements);
}

// ...existing code...
} // namespace cudarl
````

## 3. Ensure your CudaMemory class has the copyToHost method

Based on your workspace, you're using a `CudaMemory` template class. Make sure it has the `copyToHost` method:

````cpp
template<typename T>
class CudaMemory {
public:
    // ...existing methods...
    
    void copyToHost(T* host_ptr, size_t count) const {
        if (!host_ptr) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Host pointer cannot be null");
        }
        
        if (count > m_size) {
            throw std::invalid_argument("Copy count exceeds allocated size");
        }
        
        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_ptr, m_devicePtr, count * sizeof(T), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    }
    
    // ...existing code...
};
````

## 4. Fix the return type inconsistency in `python_bindings.cpp`

Your `reset()` method returns `std::vector<float>` but `getObservation()` returns `py::array_t<float>`. For consistency, update the `reset()` method:

````cpp
// ...existing code...
class PyEnvironment {
private:
    std::shared_ptr<cudarl::Environment> env;
    
public:
    PyEnvironment(int width = 10, int height = 10) {
        env = std::make_shared<cudarl::Environment>(0, width, height);
    }
    
    // Change return type to match getObservation()
    py::array_t<float> reset() {
        env->reset();
        return getObservation();
    }
    
    py::tuple step(int action) {
        env->step(action);
        auto obs = getObservation();
        float reward = env->getReward();
        bool done = env->isDone();
        py::dict info;
        info["agent_x"] = env->getAgentX();
        info["agent_y"] = env->getAgentY();
        return py::make_tuple(obs, reward, done, info);
    }
    
    py::array_t<float> getObservation() {
        int height = env->getHeight();
        int width = env->getWidth();
        auto obs_arr = py::array_t<float>({height, width});
        py::buffer_info buf = obs_arr.request();
        float* ptr = static_cast<float*>(buf.ptr);
        env->copyGridToBuffer(ptr, static_cast<size_t>(height) * width); 
        return obs_arr;
    }
    
    // ...rest of the methods...
};
````

## 5. Create a test script to verify the bindings

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import sys
import os
import numpy as np

# Add the build directory to path (adjust path as needed)
sys.path.append(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '../../build'))

try:
    import cudarl_core_python as ccp
    print("✓ Successfully imported cudarl_core_python")
    
    # Test environment creation
    env = ccp.Environment(width=5, height=5)
    print(f"✓ Created environment: {env.get_width()}x{env.get_height()}")
    
    # Test reset
    obs = env.reset()
    print(f"✓ Reset successful")
    print(f"  Observation shape: {obs.shape}")
    print(f"  Observation dtype: {obs.dtype}")
    print(f"  Agent position: ({env.get_agent_x()}, {env.get_agent_y()})")
    print(f"  Sample values: {obs[0, :3]}")  # Show first row, first 3 values
    
    # Test step
    obs, reward, done, info = env.step(1)  # Move right
    print(f"✓ Step successful")
    print(f"  New observation shape: {obs.shape}")
    print(f"  Reward: {reward}")
    print(f"  Done: {done}")
    print(f"  Info: {info}")
    print(f"  New agent position: ({env.get_agent_x()}, {env.get_agent_y()})")
    
    # Test get_observation
    obs2 = env.get_observation()
    print(f"✓ get_observation() works")
    print(f"  Same as step observation: {np.array_equal(obs, obs2)}")
    
    print("\n✓ All binding tests passed!")
    
except ImportError as e:
    print(f"✗ Import error: {e}")
    print("Make sure the module is built and in the Python path")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"✗ Runtime error: {e}")
    import traceback
    traceback.print_exc()
````
